wpcaregrid-php-cli-production-build.cgroup: the root-console helper's session or transient scope; never a *.service unit

commands_disabled.reason: Phase B stays disabled and is not authorized: it needs database DDL, AppArmor cannot tell DDL from a query on the allowed unix socket, and its current runner uses TCP host/port, which this profile never allows. It needs its own conversion and review before it could ever be enabled.

wpcaregrid-php-cli-production-build.lifetime: short-lived child of the root-console helper; never a service; none may exist in the pre-production phase or during rollback
wpcaregrid-php-cli-production-build.network: none; all socket and network access denied
wpcaregrid-php-cli-production-build.phase_b_interpreter: Phase B stays disabled and is not authorized: the profile cannot distinguish DDL from a query on the allowed socket, so keeping Phase B off is helper policy
residuals: the write grants cover every release's bootstrap/cache, including the live release that FPM includes; helper seals generated cache before activation
child stdout/stderr go to the helper and are not confinable: the helper must not store them where staging can read them
wpcaregrid-php-cli-production-build.selected_by: production root-console helper only for offline package:discover/config:cache commands; no DB or network

wpcaregrid-php-cli-production-deploy.cgroup: the root-console helper's session or transient scope; never a *.service unit

commands_disabled.reason: Phase B stays disabled and is not authorized: it needs database DDL, AppArmor cannot tell DDL from a query on the allowed unix socket, and its current runner uses TCP host/port, which this profile never allows. It needs its own conversion and review before it could ever be enabled.

commands_supported.note: connects with unix_socket set to exactly that path; no host/port, no TCP fallback; the helper must verify the observed mysqld socket and keep the exact server-UUID check

wpcaregrid-php-cli-production-deploy.lifetime: short-lived child of the root-console helper; never a service; none may exist in the pre-production phase or during rollback

mysql_unix_socket.policy: root-controlled: a fixed path in the profile and in this binding, never from the environment; the helper must verify the observed mysqld socket (path, socket type, owned by the mysql instance) equals it and keep the exact server-UUID check; any other path fails closed; the live host path has NOT been checked by B

wpcaregrid-php-cli-production-deploy.network: unix-stream connect to the exact MySQL socket only; no TCP; read-only application tree
wpcaregrid-php-cli-production-deploy.phase_b_interpreter: Phase B stays disabled and is not authorized: the profile cannot distinguish DDL from a query on the allowed socket, so keeping Phase B off is helper policy
residuals: inherited stream descriptors are not tied to the MySQL peer (the parser rejects a pathname peer address): the helper must start the CLI with no inherited sockets and close_fds
the allowed socket is a data channel: the DB grant must have no FILE, REPLICATION or SUPER privilege, secure_file_priv set and local_infile off
child stdout/stderr go to the helper and are not confinable: the helper must not store them where staging can read them
wpcaregrid-php-cli-production-deploy.runtime_probe_constraint: uses unix socket only at the fixed production MySQL path; no host/port and no TCP fallback; helper verifies observed mysqld socket and exact server UUID
wpcaregrid-php-cli-production-deploy.selected_by: production root-console helper only for the read-only runtime identity probe

inventory_schema.label_rule: label is either '<apparmor_profile> (enforce)' or the exact observed 'unconfined//&<apparmor_profile> (enforce)' stack, and unit == services[role].unit; anything else blocks
inventory_schema.membership: every process with ANY real/effective/saved/filesystem UID 33, GID 33 or supplementary group 33, plus members of nginx.service, wpcaregrid-production-php8.5-fpm.service and forbidden sentinel php8.5-fpm.service cgroups (root masters included); unknown, unconfined or unreadable peers fail closed
inventory_schema.stability: two consecutive scans identical on (pid,starttime,label,unit,uids,gids,groups); churn/unreadable/cgroup disagreement => complete=false

phases.post: production and nginx roles, route closed
phases.pre: production role excluded; production unit absent; no production secret or route

rules.class_identity: A service process is identified only by the exact (AppArmor label, systemd unit/cgroup) pair. Production FPM and Nginx are required enforced peers. Generic php8.5-fpm.service is scanned as a forbidden sentinel, not an installation or acceptance role; any process in it fails closed.
rules.deploy_cli_network: unix-stream connect to the exact MySQL socket only; no TCP
rules.production_jobs: fenced until a separate approved plan
